ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75% high-intensity (white/off-white) to 25% low-intensity (black/dark grey) across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity regions occupy the central lobes. A low-intensity contiguous band (approximately 5-10 pixels wide) defines the trailing edge. A dense, low-intensity pixel cluster is located at the fluke-peduncle junction, extending into the notch. Fine low-intensity mottling is distributed along the leading edge of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an estimated interior angle of 50 degrees; the notch vertex is sharply defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations with high frequency and variable pixel amplitude along the trailing boundary. The left lobe exhibits larger, more jagged peaks compared to the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges; trailing edges exhibit a sigmoidal trajectory, transitioning from concave near the notch to convex towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple small, low-intensity circular clusters scattered on the high-intensity background of the left lobe. High-intensity, high-contrast clusters (white calcifications) are present on the distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two parallel, near-vertical low-intensity linear marks on the lower inner quadrant of the right lobe, breaking the high-intensity background pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct white high-intensity nodes on the distal tips of both lobes; heavy irregular dark pigmentation/staining at the central peduncle interface.
other_distinctive_markers: Partial occlusion of the lower central fluke boundary by high-intensity transient pixels (water spray).
